stages.model_text:
[Opening Promise]  
The problem is that early-stage product managers often struggle to align their positioning with user needs, leading to ineffective onboarding. By using customer feedback, they can identify the most valuable aspects of the audience's journey. For example, [S#1] highlights how customer surveys revealed that users prioritize ease of navigation. This feedback helps refine the onboarding process to better meet the audience's expectations. The promise is to ensure that the onboarding is not just a one-size-fits-all experience but tailored to the specific needs of the users. Application: Make sure the onboarding process is intuitive and aligned with the audience's
